name: Ray-Adaptive Supersegment Generation
aliases: Determining the supersegment termination parameter gamma
definition: A method to automatically determine the sensitivity parameter gamma for supersegment termination for each ray independently, ensuring a maximum number of supersegments N_S per ray without manual tuning.
summary: Ray-Adaptive Supersegment Generation automatically determines the sensitivity parameter for each ray to ensure a strict supersegment budget, preventing smearing artifacts without manual tuning.
